notes.title: Changed has been released for seven years
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZO3u8iR91r8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Changed has been released for seven years. Thank you for your love and support. Changed's remake Changed-Special is still under development. You can select Changed-Special in the Changed main menu to try out the remake in advance

When the remake is completed, you don't need to buy the game anymore. The remake will be the next version update

More content is in the video!

notes.title: Thanks to everyone's support, Changed has reached new milestone, here we talk
notes.notes:
Hi players, I'm DragonSnow, the maker of ChangedːPuroHappyː
Five years have passed since Changed was released, and today I suddenly found that the number of reviews for this game on Steam has exceeded 10,000!

[h1]That's a miracle.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/f3eae2cf7e0804fa9b12b62fabbd053600a0eeab.png[/img]
It's really a huge achievement and everyone's comments are so important, thank you so much for all the love, advice, guidance, criticism and feedback!
To have such a large group of players and a friendly community is something I didn't expect at all when I first started making this game ːPuroAmazedː
It's really a miracle for me, and for that reason, I'm always trying to do something to repay your enthusiasm and love.
For the past five years, I've been working hard to recreate the entire game, and I've been working hard to make it even better.

[h1]Changed-special version development[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/1d6997be60e5bd2e96fea7b23ecfd4ce7929de6e.png[/img]
Changed-special, that's the title of the new version, which is a complete redevelopment of the old version.
The development project of this new version started five years ago, I learned a lot of experience and lessons and redeveloped it based on that
This project exists to optimize the entire game in a complete, holistic and comprehensive wayːWhiteWolfFunnyː
I redesigned the grayish color of the original version, redesigned the map, redrew the materials, and rearranged the plot
Added white edges to the objects and characters for easy identification, added new characters, new puzzles, new animations, new bosses
In response to the problem of the game being difficult, the current version already has a function that allows the main character to burst into a sprint, so chasing the battle is no longer a problem
And much, much more, this completely remade the entire game project, contains much more than what I have said
Let me show you the visual differences between the old and new versionsːMilkPuddingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/08d65288b1d6c5d2c0c9d33f776ad0a67afc9cd5.png[/img]

[h1]What? The new version is certainly more than just a visual change![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/d741980d6a68ad6169706e8cb51fdbb683aa7011.gif[/img]
New maps, new storylines, new content

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/d314cbe19fc39f88881201acffdeb69217712db3.gif[/img]
New areas, new boss battles, new interesting characters

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/d4571ed0cf59d0e07cb012b02e5a49f22f5db6dc.gif[/img]
New animations with new enemies and, of course, old friends Puro

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/09bda3f7412a90fb17b5454f07e18cc6976c87b6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/28771f024757e70a30fe29e1a62153ac913a5706.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/8eb599d1f7a413072771750eb59f9ffd5165bc1f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/f300c06e4867036c20c37d617ce0e68b6d342378.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/976d7e61b849052bf3db548a5a7e674e365d9aa6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/824d75d76277f6fd429a8f67c8adad67132b589b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/26332daaef8c86d534d3c82efe203be22e22d31d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/fdeead1740808573ef545428c6c8debd3b1e1623.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/6161fbb8890353fc2005a8331926d47fa178d612.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/91ea904c713184f35a97e23d52322c22bf21d5f0.gif[/img]
There are too many too many just too many! I can show three days and three nights without stopping!ːWhiteWolfHappyː
I still have a lot of surprises, but let's wait until the official update and let the players experience and find out for themselves

[h1]So when exactly will you be able to play it?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/9d55edc7e9790d6ab25652460dbf3c9058ec8e6b.png[/img]
Changed-special is still in development, the project progress has reached 3/4, has produced 74 maps, 190 + TF animation and plot, 560 CG mapːDoctorKː
The content that has been developed will probably have a six to nine hour process, and it may even be more if you explore it slowly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/fe63ebfe1ab51e465610cc9747c9a11c722af895.gif[/img]
After the game is updated in the future, the original version will be retained, players can choose the original version or the new version, the two versions of the achievement system is interoperable

According to the current development speed, the new version "probably" will be released at the end of this year or early next year, so please wait quietly!ːWhiteWolfIntersetː
The game's current update is completely free for players who already own the game, and those who already own the game just need to wait for the update
But after the new version is released, the price of the game will be adjusted slightly according to Steam's recommended price

Players who can't wait can also try out the new version of Early Experience content via the Changed-special option in the game's main menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/30626467c1c156c69babf8b961f66dfed4859521.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]

Once again, thank you to everyone who is willing to spend money to support this "ordinary, even a little rough game", it is you together to create this miracle!
I would even say that this new version is only possible because of your financial support, so thank you very much!
Finally, I'd like to announce another good news, my other game Silenced will be released with a lot of content demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/988960/Silenced/
The game is still being translated, and will be released as soon as the translation is complete! Please wait quietly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/4231a33f4ac78ae10a0b47ab20e19c3b61b20f63.jpg[/img]
So, we'll see you on the new version!

notes.title: Changed the second anniversary!
notes.notes:
Changed game is on its second anniversary, thank you for your support in the past two years!

Many people may already know that, to thank you, all players who have purchased the original version of the Changed game will be given a Change-special version.
(Search for changed-special in the toolbar of the steam game library and install it, as shown in the figure)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/db6673d9ef8c281f93710dc489307601fa9a27e1.png[/img]
The special version can be regarded as a remake of the original game of Changed. I have improved and remade a lot of aspects of the original story, graphics, game mechanics, etc., and added many new levels and creatures. During the update, players who want a full experience can wait for the update to play
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/83132f5759cedf4f4f0258ff11f88d30185bdef6.png[/img]
Why not use the special version as an update to the original version?
I have made a lot of changes on the basis of the original version, especially in the plot. There may be some players who will not accept it. I want the players who like the original version to keep the original version.

Will there be a free for this version?
No, subsequent updates to this version, including after the update, are completely free (provided that you already have the original Changed game)

Why are the words in the game garbled?
The game currently only supports Chinese. I have limited energy and cannot host the translation while developing. I will translate it into English after the game is completed

Finally, like the story in Changed
"Wish all people not to be affected by the disease"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32222334/0baca18031609288595293206e43c7a8ef337167.png[/img]
